ISO 11898-2 physical-layer operation at 500 kbit/s, CAN 2.0B timing, required transmit frame rates and received-frame firmware behavior require circuit, timing and built-board evidence. Native net connectivity alone does not establish them; criterion 8 remains a separate bench obligation.

BLE 5.0 RaceChrono GATT behavior and radio range to a phone in a tank bag or jacket pocket require firmware and installed-board measurements. Module identity and antenna keepout checks do not establish radio performance; criterion 9 remains a separate bench obligation.

Operation over 9 V to 16 V, ISO 7637-2 automotive transient survival with the stated 40 V clamp, reverse-polarity survival and the under-2 A power budget require captured protection/power analysis and physical evidence. Wiring and part identity checks alone do not establish survival or operation.
The pod owns the 5 V sensor rail; its 5.00 V +/-1% at 200 mA and connector-referenced ratiometry require a captured circuit contract and physical load measurements. ECU 5V_SENSOR_2 is unused.

Four 0-5 V channels with 12-bit resolution, connector-referenced ratiometry to the pod sensor supply, 16 V input protection and 200 Hz per-channel acquisition require circuit/error-budget, firmware and physical evidence. Native connectivity alone does not establish the analog transfer function or sampling performance.

See rf-source-capture.json. Source-derived RF_50 width and clearance remain undeclared. RF maximum length remains unbound without a captured design bound; 15 mm is a test value only; native width and length checks cannot establish impedance. bench.criterion: CAN frame rates within 5% and ECU .mlg channel logging on a built pod.
bench.procedure: Connect the built pod and ECU to a bench CAN bus; retain timestamped traffic for all six specified frame IDs, compare rates with the spec, and retain an ECU .mlg file showing lean, brake pressure and suspension travel.

bench.criterion: RaceChrono Pro BLE pairing and combined ECU RPM, pod lean and 25 Hz GPS speed.
bench.procedure: Pair RaceChrono Pro with the built pod over BLE; retain the app session showing ECU RPM alongside pod lean and GPS speed and measure the GPS update rate against 25 Hz.
